symbols.name: path start vertex
symbols.meaning: The first of three vertices on a path through the network.
symbols.quote: Take a path of three vertices $a$, $b$, $c$, so that the stored array changes from $D_a g$ to $D_b g$ on the first edge and from $D_b g$ to $D_c g$ on the second.

symbols.name: path middle vertex
symbols.meaning: The middle of three vertices on a path through the network.
symbols.quote: Take a path of three vertices $a$, $b$, $c$, so that the stored array changes from $D_a g$ to $D_b g$ on the first edge and from $D_b g$ to $D_c g$ on the second.

symbols.name: path end vertex
symbols.meaning: The last of three vertices on a path through the network.
symbols.quote: Take a path of three vertices $a$, $b$, $c$, so that the stored array changes from $D_a g$ to $D_b g$ on the first edge and from $D_b g$ to $D_c g$ on the second.

symbols.name: input role
symbols.meaning: An input role of the network, whose route starts at its source vertex.
symbols.quote: Write $w$ for an input role and $\rho$ for the signed role permutation realised by the scalar network, so that input role $w$ is sent to output role $\rho(w)$.

symbols.name: role permutation
symbols.meaning: The signed permutation of roles realised by the scalar network, sending each input role to an output role.
symbols.quote: Write $w$ for an input role and $\rho$ for the signed role permutation realised by the scalar network, so that input role $w$ is sent to output role $\rho(w)$.

symbols.name: route sign
symbols.meaning: The scalar sign carried by the route from input role $w$.
symbols.quote: Write $\varepsilon_w$ for the scalar sign carried by that route.

relations.quote: The endpoint operator is realised by a [linear network](linear-network-frames.md) on each role's array once all intermediate frames have cancelled, so it depends only on the frames at the two ends of a route.
